what_to_detect: A continuous effect from a resolved spell or ability with an end-of-turn duration is in force through the end step and gone after the cleanup step.
near_miss: A continuous effect with a longer duration still in force after the cleanup step.
record_fields: floating_effects duration (gen-3) in snapshots before and after cleanup

what_to_detect: A continuous effect from a resolved spell or ability stating no duration: its characteristic-changing event (color_change, type_change, pt_change ...) carries duration permanent, and the change is still in force on later turns.
near_miss: The same kind of event with a stated duration such as end_of_turn.

what_to_detect: A permanent that entered after a resolved characteristic-changing effect began is not among the effect's affected objects, though it matches the effect's selector.
near_miss: A matching permanent that was on the battlefield when the effect resolved, among the affected objects.

what_to_detect: A resolved continuous effect whose amount depends on a variable keeps the value it took on resolution after the variable's basis changes (its boost unchanged in later snapshots).
near_miss: The same kind of effect resolving after the basis changed, with the new value.

what_to_detect: An effect that applies to the next spell of a kind cast applies to that spell and leaves the command zone once it has applied, so a later spell of the kind is unaffected.
near_miss: A spell of the kind cast after the effect was used, without it.
record_fields: floating_effects (gen-3) before and after the spell_cast

what_to_detect: A permanent cast with a keyword a static granted to it as a spell (a granted keyword line with cast_with set) keeps that keyword's battlefield effects after the granting static's source left the battlefield.
near_miss: A permanent of the same kind cast without the granted keyword, with none of its effects.
record_fields: card lines[] with kind keyword, granted and cast_with (gen-3)
snapshot entity zone of the granting source
